scope: Static Library and every reachable local Play route on main after TASK-030

interactions.page: Settings, Deck editor, Profile, Story, and Match
interactions.control_family: Visible validation, persistence, Story, or authority rejection
interactions.precedence: Error supersedes the rejected operation cue
interactions.rationale: Reachable application-owned rejections receive one restrained Error only after their visible feedback exists.

interactions.control_family: Mouse entry onto a new enabled control
interactions.eligibility: Trusted mouse pointer; newly entered enabled control
interactions.rationale: One restrained positional cue; child transitions and stationary pointer movement are deduplicated.

interactions.eligibility: Trusted Tab traversal to a new enabled control
interactions.rationale: Keyboard focus is audible only when Tab navigation caused it.

interactions.control_family: First trusted activation that unlocks Web Audio
interactions.eligibility: First trusted pointer or non-modifier key activation
interactions.rationale: Unlock never produces a catch-up cue.
Touch must not chatter while a finger moves across controls.

interactions.control_family: Initial render, route change, rerender, restored focus, or scripted click
interactions.rationale: Only direct user interaction may request UI audio.

interactions.control_family: Disabled, rejected-before-handler, or semantic no-op control
interactions.eligibility: disabled, aria-disabled, resolving, or unchanged pressed/current value
interactions.rationale: Unavailable and unchanged controls must not acknowledge an action.

interactions.control_family: Brand, Library, Play, and Play subnavigation links
interactions.rationale: Top-level destination selection is a routine commit, not a spatial page swipe.
Settings creates a modal layer.

interactions.control_family: Cancel or dismiss Settings without committing the current edit
interactions.eligibility: Dialog open and trusted close request
suppression: close caused by successful save, import, reset, or tutorial launch
interactions.rationale: The explicit close button abandons uncommitted fields.

interactions.control_family: Ticket, Bench, Motion, drag, and import-confirmation value commit
interactions.eligibility: Enabled control value changed by the user
interactions.rationale: A committed setting value receives one confirmation.
Slider movement updates visible output but never emits audio; Preview is the only audition path.
The user explicitly requested one sound at the unsaved slider value.
Durable save uses the reserved positive variant.
Launch is a route selection and successful close is not sounded separately.

interactions.control_family: Export, choose backup, download current, confirm import, and confirmation disclosure controls
interactions.rationale: Each operation has visible state; errors are cued separately only after rendering.
The button opens a browser-owned confirmation layer; its native buttons remain silent.
The app cannot safely observe native confirmation controls as individual browser events.
Keystrokes and live result rerenders must remain silent.
Select controls sound once on committed value, not on each option traversal.
Tab selection changes the visible catalog subset.

interactions.eligibility: Record exists and dialog is closed
interactions.rationale: Record details open a modal layer.

interactions.control_family: Related technical-record link or authored-field disclosure
interactions.rationale: These update or disclose content inside the current detail context.

interactions.eligibility: Dialog open and user requested dismissal
interactions.rationale: Closing read-only detail does not abandon edits, so it is a neutral popup close.

interactions.region: Active deck, tutorial, match, and shortcut controls
interactions.control_family: Review deck, launch tutorial, begin Match, Deck/Profile shortcut
interactions.rationale: Every enabled Home action commits one clear selection.
The immediately saved match-setting commit receives one cue.

interactions.eligibility: Trusted enabled activation that changes selection or route
interactions.rationale: Gallery and durable deck actions acknowledge once.
Card inspection opens a modal detail layer.
Read-only inspection closes neutrally.
Native delete confirmation is a new blocking layer; its browser-owned outcome is silent.

interactions.control_family: Family, archetype, and cost filter commit
interactions.rationale: Each select filter sounds once after commitment.
Typing and live filtering remain silent.
Quantity changes receive a short acknowledgement.

interactions.eligibility: Deck valid and storage save succeeds
interactions.rationale: A completed durable deck save uses the reserved confirmation variant.

interactions.eligibility: User activates explicit back or Cancel link
interactions.rationale: These controls abandon the editing context.
Typing and dirty-state rerenders remain silent.
A changed visual identity choice is acknowledged once.

interactions.eligibility: Dirty valid profile and storage save succeeds
interactions.rationale: A completed durable profile save uses the reserved confirmation variant.

interactions.precedence: Error suppresses activation cue for the rejected operation
interactions.rationale: This is a reachable in-app rejection and therefore warrants the restrained production Error extension.

interactions.control_family: Start or continue Story after the operation is accepted
interactions.eligibility: Enabled Story operation completed and navigation is ready
interactions.rationale: Story progression waits for acceptance; prerequisite links use the bounded Play fallback.
Both controls open browser-owned confirmation layers; their native outcomes remain silent.

interactions.control_family: Choose an authored option by button or number key
interactions.eligibility: Enabled choice was accepted while not pending
interactions.rationale: Pointer, activation-key, and numeric-key routes converge on one post-acceptance choice cue.

interactions.control_family: User-requested Continue to the next beat
interactions.rationale: Manual scene progression sounds after acceptance; the timer route passes no interaction ID and remains silent.
History opens a modal layer.
Read-only history closes neutrally.

interactions.control_family: Toggle Auto, recover checkpoint, or go to Story Home
interactions.rationale: These are explicit state or route selections.
Automatic transitions never sound without direct user action.
Ticket focus changes once and rerenders remain silent.

interactions.control_family: Open full Ticket, Card detail, Documentation preview, archive review, or solution reveal target
interactions.eligibility: Target exists and requested layer is available
interactions.rationale: Each control opens a new detail or review layer.

interactions.control_family: Cancel documentation or dismiss an in-progress editable dialog
interactions.eligibility: Dialog open and action not resolving
interactions.rationale: Documentation dismissal abandons an unsubmitted preview.

interactions.control_family: Close full Ticket, Card detail, or archive review
interactions.rationale: Read-only layers close neutrally.

interactions.control_family: Bench view/type, category/sort, relevant/runnable, and diagnostic selection
interactions.rationale: Button-style Bench controls acknowledge one accepted selection.

interactions.control_family: Bench select and checkbox filter commits
interactions.rationale: Native filter controls sound only after a committed change.
Keystrokes and live Bench filtering remain silent.
Previous-page movement uses the directional fall.
Next-page movement uses the directional rise.

interactions.control_family: Expand hand, select a card, or inspect an action result
interactions.eligibility: Enabled operation changes selection or visible state
interactions.rationale: Card-selection controls receive one acknowledgement; authority-submitted intents are owned by the resolved-feedback mapping.

interactions.control_family: Candidate hypothesis/elimination/isolation, selected Card action, Document submission, Refresh, Search, Pass
interactions.eligibility: Authority has accepted the submitted legal intent and visible state is updated
interactions.rationale: The service waits for authoritative visible resolution, ensuring a rejected gesture receives Error instead of Select plus Error.

interactions.eligibility: Give Up legal and not resolving
interactions.rationale: Give Up opens a browser-owned destructive confirmation layer.

interactions.control_family: Accepted mouse/touch Card drag to a legal Ticket
interactions.eligibility: Optional drag enabled; legal different drop target; intent submitted
interactions.rationale: Only a successful spatial drag commit gets a directional cue.
Continuous motion and failed drops must not chatter or imply acceptance.

interactions.control_family: Continue, Back/re-explain, Restart, and Exit tutorial
interactions.rationale: Tutorial navigation is explicit; Exit is separately treated as cancellation.
Exit abandons the guided Match context.
Inline disclosure stays in the current surface and does not warrant popup semantics.

interactions.control_family: Continue Story, return, replay tutorial, or view Profile
interactions.rationale: Completed-result destinations use the reserved positive confirmation variant.

interactions.control_family: Worker rejection, failed Story return, content inconsistency, or start failure
interactions.eligibility: Error/rejection element is visible before request
interactions.rationale: These reachable failures have visible in-app feedback and need one restrained rejection marker.

interactions.control_family: Worker result, animation, count update, evidence reveal, focus/scroll continuity, or result render
interactions.rationale: SFX acknowledges the user's operation, never the engine's subsequent presentation steps.

interactions.page: Home, Decks, Editor, Profile, Story, Game, result and recovery
interactions.control_family: Reachable enabled control not assigned a higher-priority specialized semantic
interactions.eligibility: Trusted enabled activation that is not a no-op
interactions.rationale: The source audit found no additional semantic family; this bounded fallback prevents an accidentally silent newly reachable control while preserving precedence.
